solution_approach: Risk-stratified, iterative security remediation following a Defense-in-Depth pattern. The approach layers three distinct remediation tracks — (1) dependency supply-chain patching, (2) runtime configuration hardening, and (3) authentication/cryptography uplift — executed in severity-descending order with mandatory validation gates between phases. No single 'big bang' upgrade; instead, atomic, reviewable changesets per severity tier allow rapid rollback isolation. A trunk-based branching strategy (feature/SCRUM-29-phase-N) ensures each phase is independently mergeable and revertible. The overall design pattern is 'Secure by Default': every middleware, configuration, and dependency default is shifted to the most restrictive safe setting, with explicit opt-outs documented and justified.

implementation_plan.title: Branch Setup
implementation_plan.description: Create base branch 'feature/SCRUM-29' from main. Create sub-branches per phase: feature/SCRUM-29-phase-1, feature/SCRUM-29-phase-2, feature/SCRUM-29-phase-3.

implementation_plan.title: Phase 1 — Critical & High Dependency Patching
implementation_plan.description: Upgrade all critical and high severity vulnerable dependencies to patched versions. Run snyk test after each upgrade to confirm resolution.
implementation_plan.validation_gate: snyk test --severity-threshold=high must return 0 vulnerabilities before merge

implementation_plan.title: Phase 2 — Runtime Configuration Hardening
implementation_plan.description: Apply Helmet.js headers, CSP policies, rate limiting, and secure cookie flags. Harden all middleware defaults.
implementation_plan.validation_gate: OWASP ZAP baseline scan must pass before merge

implementation_plan.title: Phase 3 — Authentication & Cryptography Uplift
implementation_plan.description: Rotate secrets, enforce bcrypt cost factor >= 12, migrate JWT to RS256, enforce TLS 1.2+ only.
implementation_plan.validation_gate: Penetration test sign-off required before merge to main

vulnerabilities.title: Prototype Pollution
vulnerabilities.description: Versions of lodash prior to 4.17.12 are vulnerable to Prototype Pollution. The function defaultsDeep could be tricked into adding or modifying properties of Object.prototype using a constructor payload.

vulnerabilities.title: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS)
vulnerabilities.description: axios is vulnerable to Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity which could lead to a denial of service attack.
